mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_records(appointment_id, doctor_id, patient_id, diagnosis, treatment_plan, medical_advice, record_status, version, finalized_at) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{doctorId}, #{patientId}, #{diagnosis}, #{treatmentPlan}, #{medicalAdvice}, #{recordStatus}, 0, CASE WHEN #{recordStatus} = 'FINAL' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END)

INSERT INTO medical_orders(medical_record_id, item_name, dosage, frequency, quantity, instruction_text) VALUES
(#{order.medicalRecordId}, #{order.itemName}, #{order.dosage}, #{order.frequency}, #{order.quantity}, #{order.instructionText})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM medical_records WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT mr.* FROM medical_records mr INNER JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = mr.appointment_id WHERE mr.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND a.patient_id = #{patientId} AND mr.record_status = 'FINAL'
SELECT * FROM medical_records WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND record_status = 'FINAL' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM medical_orders WHERE medical_record_id = #{medicalRecordId} ORDER BY medical_order_id
